offering_description.value: Provides investment management to individuals, families and institutional investors. Its outsourced investment team builds portfolios for endowments, foundations and family offices around their financial goals, risk tolerance and mission.

quotes.quote: We offer our individual and family clients robust investment capabilities trusted by sophisticated institutions.

Silvercrest partners with endowments, foundations and family offices to provide customized, full-service investment office solutions. The firm’s outsourced chief investment officer (OCIO) team leverages decades of experience managing nonprofits and family offices in tailoring portfolios to its clients’ distinctive financial goals, risk tolerances and mission objectives.
